capabilities: Split a question into a topic mind map
Research map branches with model knowledge or web search
Plan and write illustrated picture books chapter by chapter
Pin anchors on a picture and link them to topics
Export a map as a standalone HTML file
disambiguation: Not a tool for managing or orchestrating AI agents; it builds visual research maps of a topic.
extras: Desktop only, requires Obsidian 1.13.7+. Setup, troubleshooting and known limitations are in a separate INSTALL.md. No telemetry and no stored API keys; AI features send notes, map content and selected pictures to OpenAI or Anthropic under the user's plan.
problem: Exploring a complex question in Obsidian leaves scattered notes with no visual structure and no built-in way to research branches with AI.

relations.evidence: install and sign in to Codex CLI or Claude Code
install and sign in to Codex CLI or Claude Code

summary: AI research tool that turns a question into a visual mind map, researches its branches, and writes illustrated picture books as Markdown.
